newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Moody's cuts PTT Exploration unit rating.
newsitem.headline: Moody's cuts PTT Exploration unit rating.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said it downgraded to A3 the senior unsecured rating of PTT Exploration and Production International Ltd, a guaranteed subsidiary of PTT Exploration and Production Ltd (PTTEP).
The ratings agency said the move was in conjunction with the downgrade of foreign currency ceilings for bonds and bank deposits on Thailand to A3 from A2, also announced on Wednesday.
The ratings agency said PTTEP was a sound investment grade company based on its asset base and balance sheet.

It said the company's debt rating incorporates PTTEP's strategic importance to Thailand, which extends a range of financial benefits to debtholders, and its status as a 71 percent-owned state enterprise.
Moody's said, as a result, the action parallels the outcome of Moody's review of Thailand's foreign currency ceiling on cross-border obligations.
